title: On Treating the newcomers like family
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：treat　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 treat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the researcher ① treated the newcomers like family year after year, and every student in the lab said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the researcher ② treats the newcomers like family for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ treat the newcomers like family at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ treated the newcomers like family before — a line in the paper for February 1980 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Treating the newcomers like family year after year, the researcher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tube at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ treat the fever with cold water for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Treat the fever with cold water at once and never mention it again.

By 1993 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the paper, and a new student from the next lab ⑧ treats the fever with cold water year after year every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ treated the newcomers like family again when nobody else would.

⑩ To treat the newcomers like family, my mother said in 1998, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the lab remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the lab forgets, somebody treats the newcomers like family for the whole place again and somebody must treat the newcomers like family year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 对待（一般过去式 treated the newcomers like family：1986 年研究员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 对待（一般现在 treats the newcomers like family：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 对待（不定式 to treat the newcomers like family：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 对待（过去完成时 had treated the newcomers like family：1980 年二月的研究报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 对待（动名词 treating the newcomers like family 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 治疗（treat the fever with cold water：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去治疗用凉水退那场热病）
G. v. 治疗（treat the fever with cold water：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 对待（后段两处：新来的学生照例 treats the fever with cold water，而母亲又一次 treated the newcomers like family）

items.q: to treat the newcomers like family

treated the newcomers like family again
to treat the newcomers like family

answers.why: treat 意为“对待”，1986 年研究员年年地对待把所有外来的人都当自家人，那是实验室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 treated。
treat 意为“对待”，自那以后研究员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 treats。
treat 意为“对待”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯对待把所有外来的人都当自家人”，此处为不定式 to treat the newcomers like family。
treat 意为“对待”，研究报告里 二月 那行字说明早在 1993 年之前就有人对待过，故用过去完成时 had treated。
treat 意为“对待”，研究员说“对待把所有外来的人都当自家人这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 treating the newcomers like family 作主语。
treat 意为“治疗”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去治疗用凉水退那场热病”，should ever 之后用原形 treat the fever with cold water。
treat 意为“治疗”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻治疗用凉水退那场热病（treat the fever with cold water at once），以后再也不要提起。
treat 意为“对待”，新来的学生每个学期都照例治疗用凉水退那场热病，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 treats。
treat 意为“对待”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地对待把所有外来的人都当自家人，用一般过去式 treated 叙述。
treat 意为“对待”，结尾那句是母亲 1998 年的话：要对待把所有外来的人都当自家人，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和实验室记住的那一件。

answers: In 1986 the researcher treated the newcomers like family year after year, and nobody in the lab forgot it.
Even now the researcher treats the newcomers like family for the whole place whenever the lab asks.
